description: E-commerce revenue from events sent with value and an ISO currency, like cfa('purchase', {value: 49.9, currency: 'EUR'}): totals per currency, per event and per day (site timezone), with event counts. Each currency is totalled on its own; no exchange rates. Optionally one event or one property filter. Same as GET /api/v1/sites/:id/revenue. Not the Stripe Revenue tab. Requires a paid plan (Starter or Growth); Hobby callers receive an upgrade message.

event.description: Optional event name, for example purchase.

property.description: Optional property key to filter on. Needs value.

range.description: Time range: today, 7d, 30d, 90d, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD (yesterday is the same date twice). Days follow the site timezone.

site_id.description: Site UUID, as returned by list_sites or add_website.

name: get_event_revenue
title: E-commerce revenue
